title: Independently reconstruct bundle and automate sandbox-intake decision
goal: Independently reconstruct the sandbox-only RCE package from canonical sources, compare it byte-for-byte with the committed package, and emit an automated candidate-intake decision without mutating a destination.
acceptance_criteria: reconstruction implementation does not import the bundle builder
reconstructed manifest inventory and install plan exactly match committed bytes
P0-003 authoritative receipt is present and true
decision is ALLOW_CANDIDATE_INTAKE only when all reconstruction and policy checks pass
decision never grants production installation or autonomous execution authority
tampered source inventory manifest plan or receipt fails closed
authoritative workflow commits report receipt and task state automatically
